purpose: Implement the existing EG-CONCURRENCY and EG-RESOURCE runners for the active xtask tooling scope without application behavior or Qualification Cell advancement.

change.public_seam: cargo xtask quality returned verdict and immutable target/quality/evidence report

dependency_review.rationale: The implementation uses only Rust std bounded sync channels, threads, queues, and existing reviewed xtask dependencies.

runner_changes: The active xtask scope selects only the existing EG-CONCURRENCY and EG-RESOURCE risk gates; all gate IDs, stages, budgets, coordinators, exception classes, cells, and product scopes remain unchanged.

FrozenQualificationFixtures captures concurrency-fixtures.tsv once, binds its bytes into fixture, seed, and schedule identities, and supplies those same immutable bytes to both runners and retained evidence.

EG-CONCURRENCY registers three Quality Engineering workers before Builder::spawn, gives each a one-command bounded channel, cooperative cancellation token, and shared bounded measurement channel, sends only structurally cooperative bounded commands, and records completion only after JoinHandle::is_finished plus join of that exact handle. This private thread owner proves registration, cooperative cancellation, completion, and exact observed joins. Ordinary worker startup and execution use the unchanged registered EG-CONCURRENCY stage timeout. A distinct monotonic 100ms shutdown clock starts only after timeout, cancellation, runner-ready-v1, lifecycle-stalled-v1, or another failure requests reconciliation. Every process-group probe, signal, forced kill, direct-child reap, and owned framed-stdout broker abort receives that same absolute shutdown deadline without a phase-local reset. The true-hang injection emits and flushes runner-ready-v1 through the child stdout pipe and parks without spawning an unjoinable registered worker; the parent broker reports readiness through a bounded in-process channel and the parent force-terminates and reaps the child process group. If any registered handle is still live at the worker shutdown deadline, the child emits and flushes lifecycle-stalled-v1 while retaining all handles and parks until the parent kills it; it never detaches, aborts, or attempts a blocking join. Retained evidence defines this process-backed runner as exactly one canonical controlled child step, binds that step to the frozen stage timeout, and separately records typed execution and shutdown observations.

On Unix, controlled process-group probes and TERM/KILL signals use the existing pinned rustix 1.1.4 process APIs in-process. The configured platform process-control tool remains an explicit validated and snapshot-bound portability input, but Unix reconciliation does not launch it. The removed controlled-platform-kill-v1 row is therefore a stale spawn-site removal, not a gate, timeout, or detector waiver. Repeated probe and signal phases check the same absolute 100ms shutdown deadline. If process or broker cleanup fails or overruns while handling an execution deadline or cancellation, the originating typed phase remains primary and the cleanup failure is retained as typed secondary reconciliation context; shutdown evidence continues to report the observed process-reaped and live state.

EG-RESOURCE performs real FIFO work admission, two-unit reservations, hard-pressure denial, a two-attempt retry storm bound, reservation release, queue-empty and leak checks, and three observed worker joins. The verifier independently requires exact one-to-one registered worker IDs, exact joined IDs, and unique contiguous schedule slots before deriving fairness from the observed order.

The controlled child serializes measurement-v1 and runs a diagnostic self-check, but that child check cannot pass either gate. The focused parent-owned bounded_measurement_verifier independently parses the raw child record against the parent-captured exact gate descriptor, both frozen scenario and capacity definitions, exact lifecycle-owner spawn identities, and the reconciled controlled-process verdict. It rejects malformed, missing, duplicate, extra, stale, mismatched, or semantically false fields and independently proves concurrency cancellation/join identity and resource count, slot, fairness, retry, reservation, queue, join, and shutdown bounds. Retained evidence binds the explicit parent verdict to stable verifier identity parent-bounded-measurement-verifier-v1, version 1, its registered contract digest, and SHA-256 identities for the gate descriptor, scenario registry, spawn registry, and raw measurement; child self-verification is recorded as diagnostic-only.

concurrency-spawn-sites.tsv declares stable path, symbol, kind, and semantic site IDs. The focused concurrency source-policy module tokenizes each complete production file once with comments and literals excluded, masks only complete cfg(test) items before resuming production scanning, resolves grouped and chained module or function aliases to a fixpoint, resolves glob-import source modules through that same alias closure, canonicalizes Rust raw identifiers before alias and invocation analysis, normalizes parentheses and turbofish paths, rejects forbidden thread spawn, channel, Builder and Scope spawn function items, VecDeque new, every resolved forbidden primitive value reference regardless of assignment, call, wrapping, const, or static context, and any std::thread or std::sync::mpsc glob import that can expose a forbidden primitive, and token-detects multiline spawn and spawn_scoped method calls with optional turbofish syntax. It accepts bounded sync-channel aliases, unrelated glob imports, unrelated raw identifiers, and spawn-like identifiers in comments, literals, and unrelated symbols, and fails closed if exact observed semantic sites are duplicate, stale, missing, newly unregistered, or kind-drifted.

Each bounded child receives only the gate, two frozen registries, and the registered execution timeout. It emits and flushes exactly one versioned, newline-terminated, hex-encoded outcome or error frame through its inherited stdout pipe. If stalled lifecycle control delivery encounters EPIPE or a flush failure, the child emits and flushes one bounded control-delivery-failed-v1 diagnostic through its separately owned stderr pipe and retains every live handle while parking; failure of that fallback is returned explicitly rather than ignored. The parent broker bounds and polls both descriptors, maps the fallback to the typed control-delivery execution phase, and immediately applies the same absolute process-group kill, reap, live-zero, and shutdown-time contract. If the direct child already exited between event delivery and reconciliation, the owner reaps it first, performs the nonblocking process-group probe before rejecting an exhausted deadline, and records termination-requested=false, process-reaped=true, and live=0 when the probe returns SRCH; a group that still exists at the deadline remains a typed cleanup failure rather than an omitted or false closed state. Successful lifecycle-stalled-v1 delivery retains the existing deadline phase and parked ownership behavior. The parent bounds captured bytes before allocation growth, reports exact control or broker-delivery failures through a bounded channel, closes and joins the broker inside the same absolute cleanup deadline, and accepts normal completion only after strict UTF-8, size, version, discriminator, canonical lowercase-hex, single-line, and single-frame parsing. Event-channel disconnect forces broker-worker join and is accepted only when the retained completed stdout is one valid terminal normal outcome; empty, malformed, or absent terminal state remains a typed capture failure, while a late disconnect cannot overwrite a valid retained verdict. Early EOF, parent receiver disappearance, missing, malformed, duplicate, extra, stale, oversized, or control frames at the normal outcome parser fail closed and initiate the same bounded process-group shutdown. No ambient bounded-runner outcome, readiness, or cancellation path protocol remains.

The former monolithic bounded_runners source is a 30-line facade over focused registry, protocol/outcome, resource model, scenario orchestration, and child measurement-verifier modules. Parent-owned verification remains in the independent bounded_measurement_verifier module. The newly added controlled-execution responsibilities are split into focused modules: framed_stdout_broker owns the bounded framed protocol worker and controlled_process_group owns bounded TERM/KILL, group probing, and direct-child reap orchestration; each module remains below 500 lines.

M0-08 public-seam tests are physically separated into scanner-policy, lifecycle/resource, and parent-verifier modules with shared fixture support; the unrelated evidence-staging publication race repair is outside issue 9 and is not part of this policy change.

detection_gained: Selecting either newly active gate executes a concrete bounded runner and retains a named immutable outcome instead of returning unsupported-runner failure.

An unregistered direct spawn, raw-identifier-obfuscated spawn or unbounded channel, spawn_scoped or turbofish builder spawn, direct generic unbounded channel, exact forbidden function-value import, forbidden primitive value reference in any expression context, std::thread or std::sync::mpsc glob import reached through direct or transitive module aliases, production spawn after a cfg(test) item, duplicate semantic registration, stale semantic registration, capacity drift, excess retries, pressure bypass, missing cancellation, missing observed join, duplicate or non-contiguous schedule slot, non-FIFO schedule, or residual reservation fails closed through cargo xtask quality.

A child control EPIPE or flush failure is parent-visible as a bounded actionable ControlDeliveryFailed diagnostic and typed control-delivery phase before parent measurement verification, then proves termination requested, process reaped, live=0, and elapsed within the same shutdown bound. Parent broker receiver disappearance, early stdout EOF, missing, malformed, duplicate, extra, stale-version, noncanonical-hex, oversized, or misplaced control stdout frames also fail closed and initiate bounded reconciliation; the child has no ambient outcome, readiness, or cancellation path capability to traverse or substitute.

A syntactically valid child measurement forged after the child diagnostic verifier, including a coupled post-capture registry swap, cannot fabricate a passing gate because the parent independently revalidates the frozen identities, bounds, lifecycle, and scenario semantics.

Unix shutdown no longer creates helper-process startup and reap contention inside the registered 100ms window; the controlled child remains the only new process boundary and the framed stdout reader is one registered, parent-owned, bounded thread.

The immutable report identifies the frozen scenario, schedule, seed, registered stage execution timeout, distinct shutdown bound and shutdown elapsed time, exact completed and joined worker IDs, cancellation delivery state, controlled process termination and reap state for noncooperative workers, hard pressure, retry limit, leak result, and the digest-bound explicit parent verifier result.

lifecycle_test_map.timeout_and_cancellation: Gate-specific proof: ordinary concurrency work uses the registered gate execution timeout; timeout, cancellation, runner-ready-v1, lifecycle-stalled-v1, or another failure starts one absolute monotonic 100ms shutdown deadline shared by in-process rustix process-group probe and signal operations, direct-child reap, and owned broker cleanup. Repeated TERM, probe, KILL, and probe phases receive that same absolute deadline without reset, and the configured process-control helper is not launched on Unix. Cleanup failure remains typed secondary context rather than reclassifying the primary deadline or cancellation. Structurally cooperative registered workers retain cancel-delivered, already-queued, disconnected, completed, exact joined, shutdown elapsed, and live state. already_exited_child_is_closed_when_the_group_probe_reaches_the_shutdown_deadline deterministically proves that an already reaped direct child whose final nonblocking group probe returns SRCH at the deadline is retained as closed without a stale signal; a live group at that boundary still returns typed cleanup. quality_reaps_a_runner_ready_true_hang_inside_the_registered_bound proves flushed pipe readiness, typed cancellation, termination-requested, process-reaped, shutdown elapsed at most 100ms, and live=0. quality_reaps_a_lifecycle_stall_while_the_child_retains_task_ownership proves that no unfinished JoinHandle is joined or detached: the child retains ownership after lifecycle-stalled-v1 until the parent kills and reaps it with live=0.
lifecycle_test_map.retry_and_resource: The resource scenario records hard pressure at capacity two, limits retries to two, releases all reservations, independently requires exact worker identity and unique contiguous schedule slots, and verifies FIFO order and empty queue state.
lifecycle_test_map.missing_tool: Gate-specific proof: these hermetic Rust std runners introduce no external tool dependency. Shared M0-06 proof: environment snapshot and controlled launch-failure tests preserve missing-tool failures before external detector execution.
lifecycle_test_map.malformed: The frozen concurrency fixture parser rejects bounded registry size, header, field-count, finite integer, duplicate gate, and spawn-site violations before execution. The stdout protocol separately rejects boundary overflow, malformed, missing, duplicate, extra, stale, noncanonical, and misplaced control frames before the parent measurement verifier rejects malformed, empty, missing, duplicate, extra, and noncanonical child fields.
lifecycle_test_map.stale: Gate-specific proof: the stable semantic spawn-site registry must match every observed source marker exactly, so stale or duplicate registrations fail before work runs. The parent measurement verifier rejects stale schema or scenario identities and uses the parent-captured bytes when a child attempts a post-capture registry swap. Shared M0-06 evidence identity checks cover stale revision, command, environment, raw report, and registry digest bindings.

old.result: Before the parent verifier, the controlled child first passed its own verifier, then changed worker 0 from slot 0 to slot 1. cargo xtask quality accepted the syntactically valid forged measurement and the public regression failed because no parent-owned semantic check existed.

new.result: Focused local diagnostics passed after retained RED proofs exposed post-verification child forgery, scanner alias and normalization gaps, traversal-shaped child outcome identity, and the later ambient ticket/readiness protocol and blocking fallback join. The current scanner module passed 45 of 45 public cases, including exact immediate marker ownership; lifecycle/resource passed 21 of 21 after obsolete path cases were replaced by public malformed, duplicate, oversized, pipe-readiness, and retained-handle-stall cases; parent-verifier passed 17 of 17; bounded frame parsing passed 4 of 4 boundary, missing, malformed, duplicate, extra, and oversized cases; and controlled execution passed 21 of 21, including normal framed capture, oversize rejection, runner-ready cancellation, and lifecycle-stalled deadline shutdown. The separate positive selector passed both gates and their retained verifier bindings. One intermediate parallel lifecycle run retained five failed local diagnostics because decoded child errors were truncated to 32 words before the lifecycle suffix; preserving the complete already-bounded decoded frame corrected the evidence and the complete module then passed. Earlier failed publication attempts and hard-shutdown evidence remain recorded below without reinterpretation. These results are local diagnostics, not Qualification Evidence, and do not establish merge eligibility.
